build_moe_prepare_finalize: build a MoE prepare and finalize instance using make_moe_prepare_and_finalize_no_dp_ep with modular or monolithic mode
quantize_input_tensor: quantize input tensor with FusedMoEQuantConfig using _quantize_input for fused MoE kernel execution
prepare_modular_fused_moe: prepare modular fused MoE input with topk weights, topk ids, and quant config via MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular
finalize_modular_fused_moe: finalize modular fused MoE output by applying TopK weight reduce implementation to fused expert output
prepare_monolithic_fused_moe: prepare monolithic fused MoE input with router logits and quant config via MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPMonolithic
